Goiazensolide is directly linked to Protein kinase C eta, which is a target of Oxindole. Oxindole, in turn, is a known inhibitor of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain. This implies a possible pathway where Goiazensolide may modulate the activity of Protein kinase C eta, which could then influence the function of L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain. The evidence suggests a possible regulatory relationship, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The mechanism is supported by the presence of a known inhibitor of the target enzyme, but further experimental validation is required to confirm the direct interaction between Goiazensolide and L-lactate dehydrogenase C chain.
